audit.whatIsWrong: The page invents a shield Lissandra does not have, in four places: whys[0] and spikes[0] and early credit her with a 'passive shield' that wins short trades, and whys[4], spikes[1] and mid say Frozen Tomb 'roots and grants a damage shield'.
audit.why: Her passive is Iceborn Subjugation: 'When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter.' No shield anywhere in it, and it only exists after a champion dies. Frozen Tomb does not root and does not shield either: 'If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable.' Range 550, cooldown 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Replaced the phantom shield with the real trade-winner — the Ring of Frost root at 450 — and restated Frozen Tomb as a 550-range stun with a self-cast untargetable heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. First, Ring of Frost's root is what cancels Breath of Light — the page never names the ability that ends your channel. Second, the self-cast Frozen Tomb makes her untargetable, so a beam or a Falling Star spent into it is spent on nothing; the page instead claimed her ultimate has 'no counterplay outside of flash'.
audit.why: Enemy W: 'Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them', range 450, cooldown 10/9.5/9/8.5/8. Owner Q carries the channel flag. Enemy R self-cast: 'becoming untargetable and invulnerable' while it heals her — the untargetable and heal flags both appear in the kit, and the brief's missingInteractions raise both the untargetable-dodges-burst and needs-antiheal rules.
audit.corrected: Ring of Frost named as the channel-killer in tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dontsFull[1].t, phases[3].why, spikes[0].text and early. The untargetable window is stated in loading, spikes[1].text and mid: hold the beam and the ultimate until it ends rather than spending them on a target you cannot hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lissandra is female and the full layer addresses her as male throughout: 'He wins lane', 'erase him', 'his answer range', 'his engage range', 'his roams', 'his poke answer', 'his cooldown-loaded face', 'his tower', 'His answer goes first'. Twelve fields.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js lists lissandra as female; the owner is 'you', so every third-person pronoun refers to Lissandra.
audit.corrected: All corrected to she/her, and the difficulty framing regrounded: this is a 450-root lane, not a poke lane — she has to get inside 450 to do anything, and Glacial Path at 24 seconds is the only way she gets there.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two level-chart rows rendered two answers: full phases[5].side='Skill' vs content win[5]='Aurelion Sol', and phases[6].side='Skill' vs win[6]='Aurelion Sol'. Separately phases[4].side='Lissandra' matched win[4] but its why described the OWNER winning the stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Lissandra x5, Aurelion Sol, Aurelion Sol] and agrees with the content layer. phases[5].why ('the stardust curve bends upward for good') and phases[6].why ('You are the scaling endgame') already describe the owner winning, so the sides were the outlier. phases[4].why read 'Falling Star online — the self-peel stun your kit was missing' under a Lissandra verdict, which is the row-argues-with-itself defect.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side moved to Aurelion Sol as one group; phases[4].why rewritten in the same proposal to justify the Lissandra verdict via the 550 stun and the untargetable self-cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content fields describe a pre-rework Aurelion Sol — 'wide star orbit', 'stacked star orbit', 'Q comet clear' — and credit him with a 'long-range ultimate' that threatens picks.
audit.why: The current kit is Breath of Light (750 channelled beam), Astral Flight (1500, 22/20.5/19/17.5/16), the black hole (750, 12s, percent-health execute) and Falling Star at 1250 on 120/110/100. There is no orbit and no comet.
audit.corrected: Replaced throughout with beam, black-hole executes, and The Skies Descend at 1250.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and the packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Real numbers: Ring of Frost 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 at 450, Glacial Path 24/21/18/15/12 at 1050, Ice Shard 7/6/5/4/3 at 725, Frozen Tomb 120/100/80 at 550, owner Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now lists all four enemy numbers, and the concrete sequencing line — a whiffed Glacial Path is up to 24 seconds of free beam — is in dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and report[9].

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[1].d under 'Farm the back line with E executes' carried the tradeGood W-flyby string verbatim, and dontsFull[2].d under 'Fly W into her cooldown-loaded face' carried the tradeBad string verbatim.
audit.why: Defect catalogue item 2 — the title promises one thing and the body explains another.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now describes the black hole's 12s percent-health execute clearing from 750; dontsFull[2].d now describes what landing inside 450 with her root up actually costs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Templated fields carried from other matchups: enemyWin ('wins by landing X, denying your pattern'), ahead, breakdown.carry, breakdown.early, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d.
audit.why: Template sweep — each reads identically on other enemies with a different ability name pasted in.
audit.corrected: All rewritten against Lissandra's real ranges and cooldowns inside the length band.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: The two suspectNames the packet flagged ('Ice Shard-', 'Frozen Tomb's') are FALSE POSITIVES — both are Lissandra's real ability names. The genuine errors were about what those abilities DO: the page gave her a 'passive shield' that does not exist anywhere in her kit (Iceborn Subjugation creates Frozen Thralls off dead champions; it shields nothing) and described Frozen Tomb as a root with a damage shield when it is a 550-range stun, or a self-cast untargetable heal. It also told the player there is 'no counterplay outside of flash' to her ultimate, which hides the actual counterplay: when she self-casts she is untargetable, so a beam or a Falling Star spent into it is wasted. As with the other four matchups in this slice, I declined the supplied missingInteraction claiming Astral Flight shuts off Glacial Path — it derives from a terrain flag that contradicts Riot's text, 'Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction'; he does not create terrain. Level chart: full phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' against content win[] and packet.levelChart; fixed both, and rewrote phases[4].why, which described the owner winning a stage the row awards to Lissandra.
